import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
E=eps; TT=T; y=sigma
fams={
'A': (lambda p: p[0]*E**p[1]*np.exp(p[2]/TT)+p[3]*TT**p[4]*np.exp(p[5]*TT)+p[6]*E**p[7]*np.exp(p[8]*TT)),
'B': (lambda p: p[0]*E**p[1]*TT**p[2]+p[3]*E**p[4]*np.exp(p[5]*TT)+p[6]*np.exp(p[7]/TT)),
'C': (lambda p: p[0]*E**p[1]*np.exp(p[2]*E)+p[3]*TT**p[4]*np.exp(p[5]/TT)+p[6]*E*TT**p[7]),
'D': (lambda p: p[0]*np.exp(p[1]*E)*TT**p[2]+p[3]*E**p[4]*np.exp(p[5]/TT)+p[6]*TT**p[7]),
'E': (lambda p: p[0]*E**p[1]*np.exp(p[2]*TT)+p[3]*E**p[4]*np.exp(p[5]/TT)+p[6]*TT**p[7]),
}
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
for name,f in fams.items():
    best=np.inf; bp=None
    for s in range(40):
        p0=rng.normal(0,1,9)
        try:
            with np.errstate(all='ignore'):
                r=least_squares(lambda p: np.nan_to_num(f(p)-y,nan=1e3,posinf=1e3,neginf=-1e3), p0, max_nfev=2000)
            v=np.mean(r.fun**2)/np.var(y)
            if np.isfinite(v) and v<best: best=v; bp=r.x
        except Exception: pass
    print(name, best, None if bp is None else np.round(bp,3))
